patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Square Online and Tiendanube share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Square Online and Tiendanube share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Square Online only if your buying job matches “Square ecosystem online store — Free $0/mo (higher online processing), Plus $49/location, ” rather than Tiendanube's shape. Choose Tiendanube only if your buying job matches “LATAM hosted commerce (Tiendanube / Nuvemshop brand) — Argentina ARS tiles: Inicial $0, Es” rather than Square Online's shape. Workflow advantage: Square Online leans omnichannel-retail; Tiendanube leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Square Online and Tiendanube share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Square Online is Square ecosystem online store — Free $0/mo (higher online processing), Plus $49/location, Premium $149/location; 30-day trials on paid tiers; Tiendanube is LATAM hosted commerce (Tiendanube / Nuvemshop brand) — Argentina ARS tiles: Inicial $0, Esencial ~$20 USD, Impulso ~$59 highlighted, Escala .
- Company-size focus: Square Online (solo, micro, small-business) vs Tiendanube (small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Square Online-leaning omnichannel-retail vs Tiendanube-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Square Online — Best fit inside Square POS ecosystem — weaker as standalone SaaS platform vs Shopify; Tiendanube — Regional LATAM focus — not a global Shopify peer for every market.

Limitations — Square Online: Best fit inside Square POS ecosystem — weaker as standalone SaaS platform vs Shopify; Free tier online processing spread (3.3% + 30¢) can exceed paid-tier savings at volume; Tiendanube: Regional LATAM focus — not a global Shopify peer for every market; USD amounts are FX approximates; ARS tiles are the source of truth.

Poor-fit cases: Square Online is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Best fit inside Square POS ecosystem — weaker as standalone SaaS platform vs Shopify · Tiendanube is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Regional LATAM focus — not a global Shopify peer for every market · Avoid Square Online if you actually need Tiendanube's motion (LATAM hosted commerce (Tiendanube / Nuvemshop brand) — Argentina ARS tiles: Inic)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
